name: The Scroll II, then the Mugiwara Store
why: A short morning with one big work of art and one big shop. We meet before the gallery opens, so you walk in first, then take a taxi to Shibuya.
bars: Meet and talk at Azabudai Hills
steps: About 1 minute on foot from Exit 5 of Kamiyacho Station (Hibiya Line). The gallery opens at 11:00, so we use the half hour to talk about what you are about to see.
ONE PIECE / The Scroll II (about 50 min)
Eiichiro Oda's Hundred Views of Pirates, printed on handmade Echizen washi paper with the collotype method. Shueisha Manga-Art Heritage Tokyo Gallery, Garden Plaza A, B1.
About 15 to 20 minutes, depending on traffic. This is an estimate.
The official ONE PIECE goods shop, on the 6th floor of MAGNET by SHIBUYA109. Open 10:00 to 21:00.
From here, Shibuya Station and the scramble crossing are a short walk.
stops: Shueisha Manga-Art Heritage Tokyo Gallery, Azabudai Hills
moves: Meeting point to gallery: 1 minute on foot. Gallery to Shibuya: taxi, about 15 to 20 minutes (estimate).
good: Fans who want the art first and the shopping second, in two hours.
mind: The gallery is closed on some days; check its calendar before you go. Works are limited to one of each per person, and the gallery's tax-free sales service ends on 1 November 2026. The Mugiwara Store can be crowded.
